xBRIEFInfo.description: Remove claim labels throughout current course documentation and organization-specific wording from all course modules

plan.title: Remove claim labels and 3Ci-specific module language

narratives.Description: Remove the three claim-type labels and their explanatory taxonomy from every learner-facing course artifact while retaining the underlying guidance. Rewrite all organization-specific 3Ci wording in the eleven numbered modules as neutral course, repository, or safety language.
narratives.Scope: Current course Markdown under README.md, curriculum/, labs/, solutions/, assessments/, templates/, references/, and maintainers/ that contains the retired claim-label taxonomy; the project-definition rule that requires those labels; every 3Ci reference under curriculum/modules/; and the JavaScript content contracts and tests that enforce the label system.
narratives.OutOfScope: Directive behavior changes, release-pin changes, lab-command changes, project identity and private-repository governance unrelated to the retired labels, historical completed xBRIEF records, framework changes, publishing, remote delivery, and lifecycle closeout.
narratives.Approval: David approved the preserve-and-generalize route on 2026-09-14.

items.title: Remove claim-label syntax and explanatory sections

narrative.Acceptance: No current learner, author, maintainer, or reference documentation contains [Directive behavior], [3Ci policy], or [Course guidance], and the prose remains grammatical without label-taxonomy instructions.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: Local feature-branch scan returned zero retired label terms across README, curriculum, labs, solutions, assessments, templates, maintainers, references, and PROJECT-DEFINITION; all content contracts passed.

items.title: Remove organization-specific wording from all numbered modules

narrative.Acceptance: A case-insensitive search of curriculum/modules/ finds no 3Ci, 3 Ci, or 3-Ci reference, while each former policy passage retains its applicable course or safety meaning.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: Case-insensitive scan of curriculum/modules returned zero 3Ci, 3 Ci, or 3-Ci matches; Modules 2-11 and the Modules 4-5 combined content contracts passed.

items.title: Replace positive label requirements with regression checks

narrative.Acceptance: Focused verifier tests and the aggregate project gate pass, and the verifier suite rejects any reintroduced claim label.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: test:portability passed 54/54 including LF and CRLF negative cases for reintroduced labels and module-specific organization language; all module/capstone content checks and task deft:check exited 0.
